Second quarter adjusted operating income increased nearly 8% year over year, primarily driven byincreased prescription and front store volume,partially offset by continued pharmacy reimbursement pressure.
Same store pharmacy sales and same store prescription volumes increased by ~18%²and ~6%², respectively, over the prior year quarter.
Continued growth in retail pharmacy script share, reaching ~27.8% inthe second quarter.

Raised 2025 adjusted operating income guidance to at least $5.68 billion,reflecting a ~$2oO million increase, driven by our strong first half performance, while continuing to maintain a prudent outlook for the remainder of the year.
